Bir Lachit Borphukan College has been an Arts College of co-education for more than four decades
and was established in 1981. The college has been shifted to the present location at Namtial Pather,
Sivasagar in 1999 and celebrated its Silver Jubilee in 2006. It has been imparting Three Year B.A.
Programme in General Standard (from 1984-85 to 2018-19) with subjects in English, Assamese,
Economics, Education, History, Political Science & Sociology. The College also started TDC B.A. in
Major Standard with subjects: Assamese & Political Science (from 1999-2000 - continuing), Sociology
(2000-2001 –continuing), Economics & English (2003-2004 –continuing), History & Education (2005-
2006 –continuing) and PGDCA & IT (2016-2017 to 2021). In 2007, the college has been included
under Section2(f)ofUGC.ThePostof12Nos.ofAssistantProfessorhavebeenprovincializedby the Govt. of
Assam in 2013. The college obtained Permanent Affiliation from Dibrugarh University in 2015. The
college has been declared fit to receive central assistance in terms of Rules framed under 12 (B) of
the UGC Act, 1956 on 30/12/2015. In 2021, 8 Nos. of Assistant Professor have been provincialized
leaving behind 9 Nos of Assistant Professor and 1 no. of Librarian as dropped one. In spite of all odds,
college has gone for Assessment and Accreditation by NAAC and has been accredited with B+ (CGPA
-2.65). College has been conferred Autonomous Status by UGC on 24th April, 2024.

It needs to be mentioned that the college has been a STUDY CENTRE of Krishna Kanta Handique
State Open University (KKHSOU) since 2008. The STUDY CENTRE offers the following courses:

        B.A. Since 2008.
        Bachelor of Mass Communication since 2008.
        Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) since 2009.
        Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) since 2009.
        M.A. (Assamese) since 2012.               M.A. (Pol. Science) since2012.
        M.A. (Sociology) since 2013.              M.A. (Education) since 2014.
        M.A. (English) since 2015.                M.A. (Economics) since2015.
        D.EL.ED. Course from 2012– 2013.

    DIPLOMA COURSE:
             Diploma in International & Mass Communication (DIMC) since 2009.
             Diploma in Library and Information Science (DLIC) since 2011.

The college has also been a Study Centre of Directorate of Open and Distance Learning (DODL) offering
courses, viz., BCA, PGDCA and Post Graduate (Assamese, Political Science, Sociology and Education). For
students unable to complete 10+2, AHSEC offers Assam State Open Schooling (ASOS) to attain that
qualification and our college is a part of that system.

 Institutional Opportunity:

       Sufficient space for development of physical infrastructure to fulfill various needs of the
        college. There is a plot of land for Girls’ Hostel if Govt. allocates sufficient fund. Approx. 3
        acres of land are lying unused which may be used for sports complex or may be used as a
        fishery for income generation.
       Infrastructure development for vocational courses beside the Boys’ Hostel.
       Minimize drop out and failure rate by rigorous mentoring to the students. Increase in drop
        out and failure rate has been taking place in the 2nd Semester onward on account of non-
        availability of fee waiver by State Govt., if there is back log in the 1st semester or in the
        next. Awareness among students and parents of this jeopardy has been created. Special
        care by the faculties has been taken to increase the attendance of slow learners in the class.
        In addition, there is sufficient increase in the number of remedial / tutorial / additional
        classes for the students whose academic progress is very poor. 
       Training of students in cricket and Gym by our collaborative partners. Workshops on cultural
        activities by our expert students and alumni in music, dance and yoga.

                                            LIBRARY

Presently the Library has total number of 10650 books (as on 02.07.2022) with 5320 titles,
besides periodicals, newspapers, manuscripts (Soft Copy) and some rare books. The
institutional repositories and Digital Collection through D-Space help the needy readers to
retrieve their required study materials.

The facilities and services available in the library are : Open access, free Internet browsing,
DELNET, NLIST, NDLI accessibility, book bank facility, external membership , current
awareness service, selective dissemination of information, Bir Lachit Borphukan collection,
Srimanta Sankardeva collection , children corner, e-resources, OPAC and Web-OPAC, digital
repository, bibliographic service, manuscript archive, institutional repository, North East
collection, collection on woman, un interrupted power supply etc.

Some of the BLBC Central Libraries best practices are: Open access, e-books and e-journals
accessibility, library best reader award, application of social media, taking users’ feedbacks
and timely response, digital repository, manuscript archive, library bulletin board ,collection
development in different formats, campus LAN, instant messaging , reference service,
suggestion box, etc.

                                       ATTENDANCE

Regular attendance is expected from the students. Minimum 80% attendance is
compulsory for all students as prescribed by the university & AHSEC.

                          Interaction with Parents/Guardians

   1. Parents and guardians are requested to co-operate with the college fraternity
      regarding rules, attendance and character building of their sons/daughters. Rules
      and Regulations are uploaded in the college website : www.blbcollege.org.in
   2. Parents are requested to meet the HOD & Principal as and when required for the
      interests of the students.
   3. Feedback reports in Google Forms are taken from all stakeholders (Students,
      Teaching and Non-teaching Staff, Library, Guardians and Alumni). They are analyzed
      by experienced Educationists of repute and then remedial actions are taken as
      suggested. At last, IQAC prepares Action Taken Reports (ATR) and uploads in the
      college website.
